AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'PlateMate Base Infrastructure (LocalStack Compatible)'

Resources:

  # 1. S3 Bucket for the Frontend SPA
  FrontendBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: platemate-frontend-app

  # 2. CloudFront Distribution (LocalStack will just mock this successfully without error)
  # We associate it with the bucket created above
  CloudFrontDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        DefaultRootObject: index.html
        CustomErrorResponses:
          # This is critical for React Router (SPA routing)
          - ErrorCode: 403
            ResponseCode: 200
            ResponsePagePath: /index.html
          - ErrorCode: 404
            ResponseCode: 200
            ResponsePagePath: /index.html
        Origins:
          - DomainName: !GetAtt FrontendBucket.RegionalDomainName
            Id: S3Origin
            S3OriginConfig: {} # In a real deploy, we'd use Origin Access Control (OAC)
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: S3Origin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          ForwardedValues:
            QueryString: false

  # 3. DynamoDB Tables
  UsersTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: platemate-users
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: userId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: userId
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST

  ReviewsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: platemate-reviews
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: reviewId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: userId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: reviewId
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: UserReviewsIndex
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: userId
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST

  RestaurantsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: platemate-restaurants
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: placeId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: placeId
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST

  # 4. IAM Role for Lambda
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource: "*"

  # 5. Lambda Function
  ApiLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: platemate-api-handler
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: nodejs20.x
      Code:
        S3Bucket: !Ref FrontendBucket
        S3Key: lambda.zip
      Environment:
        Variables:
          REVIEWS_TABLE: !Ref ReviewsTable
          USERS_TABLE: !Ref UsersTable
          AVATAR_BUCKET: !Ref FrontendBucket
          RESTAURANTS_TABLE: !Ref RestaurantsTable
          GOOGLE_API_KEY: "AIzaSyCc6dbp4JMtFEzL3d1VR3bymT-1hj4gt1A"
          # Mock data flag for local testing if needed
          USE_MOCK_DATA: "true"



  # 6. API Gateway (REST API v1 for LocalStack Free Tier compatibility)
  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: platemate-rest-api
      Description: API for PlateMate

  ApiGatewayResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: "{proxy+}"

  ApiGatewayMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ApiGatewayResource
      HttpMethod: ANY
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${ApiLambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations"

  ApiGatewayRootMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: ANY
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${ApiLambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations"

  ApiGatewayDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ApiGatewayMethod
      - ApiGatewayRootMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi

  ApiGatewayStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiGatewayDeployment
      StageName: dev

  LambdaApiPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref ApiLambdaFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/*/*"



Outputs:
  FrontendBucketName:
    Value: !Ref FrontendBucket
    Description: Name of the Amazon S3 bucket used for frontend hosting.
  CloudFrontDomain:
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFrontDistribution.DomainName
    Description: Domain name of the CloudFront distribution for the frontend.
  ApiEndpoint:
    Value: !Sub "http://localhost:4566/restapis/${RestApi}/dev/_user_request_"

    Description: Local URL of the test API Gateway endpoint.
